name: issue-edit
alt: Next issue with Edit open on Rural Schools Symposium: Save and Cancel at the top, its fields, then Type, Subtype, ERC Newsletter only and Add media.

pins.label: Type and Subtype: what the item is, open to change even after Keep
ERC Newsletter only: ticked, it skips the Policy Exchange
Add media: a picture or a PDF flyer
Save: keeps the changes. Cancel drops them

name: schedule
alt: Newsletter's Schedule tab: a warning that send dates end Oct 27, the Oct 27 date marked Next with 4 in the issue, and Edit dates on the Sheet's schedule tab.

pins.label: Shows a week before the last send date: time to add the next ones
A send date: press it to open that issue on Next issue
The Sheet's schedule tab: opens it in a new tab

name: publish-live
alt: Publish with a live headline's row open: Already live in its Fate column, and under it Edit with the line An edit here changes the desk, not the site.

pins.label: Already live: the item is on the site. Click its row to open it
Edit: changes the desk's copy, never the site

name: exchange-hub
alt: The Policy Exchange page: the Publish and Highlight doors, Highlight with 2 on the home page, then the site's status, then Edit live items and its note.

pins.label: Edit live items: the site's own editor, in a new tab, with the team password
Highlight: the home page's big card, with Add photo for each pick

name: listserv
alt: The Listserv page's left column: To be added with a count of 3 counted as the page opened, Open the sign-up sheet and the three steps, then the sign-up form's status.

pins.label: To be added: the rows on Sheet 1 when the desk was loaded
Open the sign-up sheet: names and addresses, in a new tab

name: scraper
alt: The Content queue's right column: the Content Sort door, then Scraper with Run the scraper and the last run's line, Open the sheet and the files.

pins.label: Run the scraper: starts a run now
The last run: what it found. Open the sheet goes to Newsletter scrapes
